# Getting Support for TorusGuard

Thank you for using TorusGuard! Here is how to find help, report issues, or connect with maintainers.

---

## 🔒 Security Vulnerabilities
If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in TorusGuard itself, please do **not** open a public issue. Follow our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md) to report it privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/security/advisories/new).

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports & False Positives
* If you found an error in skill definitions, templates, or markdown links: [Open a Bug Report](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
* If a TorusGuard rule incorrectly flags safe code in your project: [Open a False Positive Report](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/issues/new?template=false_positive.md).

---

## 💡 Feature Ideas & New Rules
* Want to propose a new security rule ID (`TG-...`): [Submit a Security Rule Proposal](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/issues/new?template=rule_proposal.md).
* Want a guide for a new language/framework: [Request a Platform Guide](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/issues/new?template=new_platform.md).

---

## 💬 Community Questions & Usage
* For general questions on how to install or configure TorusGuard in your AI tools, check [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/githubmofo/TorusGuard/discussions) or the [README](../../README.md).
